title: The Generation Gap: Exploring Age Bias in the Value Systems of Large Language Models
findings: For the 'Religious Values' category, most tested LLMs exhibited a significant trend of being more aligned with the values of younger demographics compared to older demographics in the US. A case study showed that for a question about attending religious services, ChatGPT's response was most similar to the youngest age group (18-24) and least similar to the oldest (65+).

measurement_description: The benchmark measures the alignment of Large Language Model values with those of different human age groups concerning 'Religious Values'. This was assessed using questions from the World Value Survey, such as the perceived acceptability of one's own religion as the only one and the frequency of attending religious services.
